NDC Zoho · Client Complaints › GDS B2B · Create ticked together with Field Update (Related Branch, Status)

rows: "Create" can be ticked together with "Field Update": the rule runs when the ticket is created and later only when the chosen fields change. 38 of NDC's core rules use this.
The options are exclusive. "Field Changed" runs on edits only (QA NDC Close Ticket did not fire on a new ticket). "Create or Edit" fires on every edit, not only when the chosen fields change.
Related Branch, Status; runs when any of them changes.
Watch field list with "any" or "all" works, but only for edits.
